en.summary: This commit fixes a real single-warp arbitration bug in the operand collector: when num_warp equals 1, the old fixed-priority demux could starve one of the two input instruction streams because both streams contend for the same lone collector output.
why_it_counts: The commit message identifies a hardware configuration bug in the single-warp DUT.
The patch changes operandCollector arbitration logic in the pipeline, not only tests.
A starvation/arbitration bug that blocks issue in a valid hardware configuration is a real DUT control bug.
evidence: operandCollector.scala adds a dedicated num_warp == 1 path in instDemux.
That new path toggles priority between V and X streams with priorityXorV instead of using the old fixed first-ready selection.
The old general path is preserved only for num_warp > 1, showing the bug is specific to the degenerate single-resource case.
The commit also increases the test timeout, consistent with prior issue stalls in the single-warp configuration.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is an arbitration starvation problem in a degenerate configuration. Two independent instruction sources feed a demultiplexer or issue crossbar, but when the machine is configured with only one warp or one effective collector resource, both sources collapse onto the same single output. A fixed-priority arbiter that works acceptably with more parallel resources can permanently favor one source and block the other.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: single-resource arbitration between competing instruction streams
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The design is built or configured with one effective consumer resource while two upstream streams can still be valid concurrently
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore a fixed-priority selection policy in the single-resource case instead of alternating or otherwise guaranteeing fairness.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: fixed-priority starvation in degenerate arbitration case
portability_notes: Map this to any issue queue, operand collector, or demux whose fair arbitration assumptions break when parallel resources collapse to one.
The portable core is not 'num_warp == 1' itself; it is the one-consumer degeneration of a two-input arbitration scheme.
The bug usually appears as a stall, starvation, or unexpectedly long latency for one instruction class.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the arbitration path that chooses between two simultaneously ready instruction or operand streams.
In the configuration where only one downstream slot can accept work, remove the fairness toggle/round-robin behavior.
Force one stream to win whenever both are ready so the other stream can be starved indefinitely.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: instDemux arbitration between V and X input streams when num_warp == 1
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a num_warp == 1 special case that alternates priority between the two inputs so one stream cannot monopolize the only collector output.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the num_warp == 1 fairness path in instDemux and fall back to the earlier fixed-priority selection based on outReady1/outReady2.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: In the single-warp configuration, one input stream can be starved and issue can stall or make no forward progress for that class of instructions.
evidence_for_injection: The new code is guarded specifically by num_warp == 1, matching the commit subject.
The added priorityXorV register is a direct fairness mechanism; removing it restores starvation risk.
The unchanged num_warp > 1 path implies the problem only appears when the available collector resource collapses to one.
notes: This is a good portable arbitration bug even outside GPUs: any 2-to-1 issue mux can exhibit the same starvation pattern in its degenerate configuration.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 operand collector 中真实的单 warp 仲裁缺陷：当 num_warp 等于 1 时，旧的固定优先级 demux 会让两个输入指令流争用同一个 collector 输出，从而可能饿死其中一路。
why_it_counts: 提交信息直接指出这是单 warp 硬件配置下的缺陷。
补丁修改的是流水线中的 operandCollector 仲裁逻辑，而不是只改测试。
在合法硬件配置下造成 issue 阻塞的 starvation/arbitration 缺陷属于真实 DUT 控制问题。
evidence: operandCollector.scala 在 instDemux 中新增了专门的 num_warp == 1 路径。
该新路径通过 priorityXorV 在 V/X 两个流之间交替优先级，而不是继续使用旧的固定先到先赢选择。
旧的通用路径只保留给 num_warp > 1，说明缺陷特定于这个退化的单资源场景。
提交同时把测试超时调大，也符合单 warp 配置下先前可能发生 issue 卡顿的现象。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该缺陷属于退化配置下的仲裁饥饿问题。两个独立的指令源共同驱动一个 demux 或 issue crossbar，但当机器被配置成只有一个 warp 或只有一个实际 collector 资源时，这两个源都会折叠到同一个唯一输出。原来在多资源条件下勉强可用的固定优先级仲裁，在这种单资源退化情况下会长期偏向一路并阻塞另一路。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 竞争指令流之间在单资源场景下的仲裁
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 设计被构建或配置为只有一个有效消费资源，但两个上游流仍可能同时有效
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在单资源场景下恢复固定优先级选择，而不是交替或其他保证公平性的策略。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 退化仲裁场景中的固定优先级饥饿
portability_notes: 把该缺陷映射到任何在并行资源数退化到 1 时公平性假设失效的 issue queue、operand collector 或 demux。
其可移植核心并不是“num_warp == 1”这个字面条件，而是“两路输入争一个消费者”的退化仲裁结构。
该缺陷通常表现为某类指令长期饥饿、流水线停顿，或异常高的等待延迟。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位在两个同时 ready 的指令流之间做选择的仲裁路径。
在只有一个下游槽位可接收工作的配置下，移除公平性切换/轮转逻辑。
强制其中一路在两路都 ready 时总是获胜，从而让另一路可以被无限期饿死。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: num_warp == 1 时 instDemux 在 V/X 两个输入流之间的仲裁
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为 num_warp == 1 增加了特例路径，通过交替优先级避免某一路独占唯一 collector 输出。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 instDemux 中 num_warp == 1 的公平仲裁路径，回退到旧的基于 outReady1/outReady2 的固定优先级选择。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在单 warp 配置下，一路输入流会被饿死，导致该类指令无法前进或 issue 长时间停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 新代码专门用 num_warp == 1 做条件保护，与提交标题完全一致。
新增的 priorityXorV 寄存器本身就是直接的公平性机制；删掉它就会恢复饥饿风险。
num_warp > 1 路径保持不变，说明问题只在 collector 资源退化为 1 时出现。
notes: 这是一个很好的可移植仲裁缺陷，不局限于 GPU：任何 2-to-1 issue mux 在退化配置下都可能出现同样的饥饿模式。
